statements.description: Each production AI system must record an AI Act risk class that is not prohibited.

keys.question: What is the AI Act risk class of production AI in this project?
keys.explanation: prohibited if the use is banned. high_risk if Annex III uses (education, hiring, access control). limited if transparency duties only. minimal if no special duties. not_applicable if the project has no production AI. Leave empty if not yet classified.

statements.description: High-risk AI that affects people must have a named human reviewer.

keys.question: Is a named human reviewer in the loop for AI decisions that affect people?
keys.explanation: yes if a named reviewer can override or approve outputs. no if scoring or ranking is fully automated. not_applicable if the system is not high-risk or has no production AI.

statements.description: High-impact AI outputs must be logged for at least 90 days.

keys.question: Are high-impact AI outputs logged for at least 90 days?
keys.explanation: yes if logs of scoring, ranking, or recommendations are retained ≥ 90 days. no if unlogged. not_applicable if there are no high-impact AI outputs.

statements.description: Production AI features must publish a model card (purpose, family, limitations).

keys.question: Is a model card published for production AI features?
keys.explanation: yes if purpose, model family, and known limitations are documented. no if production AI is undocumented. not_applicable if there is no production AI.
